product.name: Toxic Teddies: Arrow Escape
product.architecture: Vite JavaScript SVG bundled through Capacitor 8

designSystem.source: Owner-supplied Toxic Teddies Design System board

typography.runtimeDisplayPolicy: Use approved illustrated Toxic Teddies branding where exact lettering is required.

runtimeDesignImplementation.appShell: Grime 900 and Ink 900 dark distressed surfaces
runtimeDesignImplementation.boardPolicy: Rendered arrow gameplay receives the largest safe mobile area. Background art crops and persistent chrome compresses before the puzzle is reduced.

loadingScreen.artwork: Owner-approved full-screen portrait Toxic Teddies Arrow Escape intro with Toxic Toby in the radioactive laboratory
loadingScreen.delivery: Approved WebP data URI assembled from committed source parts and assigned to the splash image during bootstrap

gameplayBackdrops.presentation: The selected local WebP is resolved to an absolute URL, preloaded, and applied directly to the gameplay view. Future mobile work may crop but may never stretch it.

rejectedScale.reason: Side paths and ears clipped outside the gameplay canvas

mobilePuzzleScale.lockedRule: Measure actual rendered path bounds with getBBox and getScreenCTM. Enforce minimum size, maximum persistent-chrome height, accessible touch targets, background crop without distortion, and no clipping.

activeNextAction.summary: Verify the published full-screen v47 intro, dark colorless trough, moving green fill and handoff on a real phone; then resume compressed-menu gameplay-first mobile implementation.

knownDefects.title: Completion progression stopped after Evil Grin
Runtime interface drifted away from the locked design system
Illustrated loading bar looked permanently full

artwork.placeholderPolicy: Use clearly non-final placeholders only. Do not generate or substitute final character art without owner approval.

requirements: The arrow puzzle is the dominant screen object
The Teddy silhouette is immediately recognizable
Rendered paths target approximately 90 to 94 percent of usable gameplay width
Rendered paths target at least 52 percent of portrait gameplay height when the silhouette permits it
Persistent top status and bottom chrome stays at or below approximately 24 percent of gameplay height
Background art may crop before the puzzle is reduced and may never stretch
Compact controls retain at least 44 CSS-pixel touch targets
No path arrowhead face-critical feature or exit lane is clipped or covered
